chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
People are the progeny of the world, and no one can be blamed for loving the mother.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'People are the children of the world' in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this famous maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) employs the metaphor of the world as a mother to explain the innate, natural attachment humans have to worldly life. This saying is often cited in Shia scholarly tradition to illustrate that while love for the world is not inherently blameworthy, it becomes a spiritual danger when it distracts from the ultimate goal of the Hereafter, a theme deeply explored in the chapter 'People's love for the world as their mother'.
